objective.question: Can an opt-in raw/nav-only reconnaissance at an unrestricted elevation gate recover a deterministic quality anchor when normal elevation-gated quality-anchor reconnaissance has no eligible candidate?

algorithm_contract.normal_reconnaissance_first: Run the existing quality-anchor SPP reconnaissance first with the configured normal elevation gate and unchanged SNR, broadcast-navigation, health, geometry, and residual quality gates.
algorithm_contract.recovery_trigger: Only when normal quality-anchor reconnaissance produces no eligible candidate; no recovery reconnaissance is permitted after a normal candidate is selected.
algorithm_contract.recovery_reconnaissance: Re-run the same raw pseudorange plus broadcast-navigation SPP reconnaissance with only the elevation gate set to -90 degrees. Preserve all SNR, health, ephemeris, navigation, finite-geometry, pseudorange, GDOP, residual, and satellite-count eligibility gates.
algorithm_contract.ranking: Use the existing deterministic quality-anchor candidate ranking unchanged: maximum satellites, then minimum GDOP, then minimum normalized residual RMS, then lowest input index.
algorithm_contract.replay: When recovery selects an eligible anchor, use its raw/nav-derived ECEF position and clock state as the first state at the anchor index, then return to the ordinary elevation=0 degree forward/backward replay. The factor builder remains on the ordinary elevation=0 degree path.
algorithm_contract.failure_policy: Recovery disabled, untriggered, or unsuccessful remains fail-closed. Keep the candidate-specific seed unavailable and do not apply a sentinel factor-level global bypass or any elevation-mask bypass in factor construction.
algorithm_contract.default: Flag-off and all existing flags retain production/default behavior and the Phase31 quality-anchor path byte-for-byte.
algorithm_contract.summary_visibility: Expose normal and recovery candidate counts, recovery trigger, selected anchor index/satellite count/GDOP/normalized residual, replay validity, and sentinel factor bypass=false. Existing candidate-specific fields are omitted from other five routes after the declared comparison projection.

summary_contract.other_route_projection: For the other five routes, compare flag-on and flag-off submission/summary after excluding the existing normal quality-anchor fields and all declared recovery candidate-specific fields; the projected artifacts must be byte-identical.

flag_off_identity_contract.scope: Run the frozen base recipe before and after candidate build on all six structural routes.
flag_off_identity_contract.expected_baselines: Existing Phase31/Phase37 frozen flag-off artifacts remain authoritative; no baseline bytes may change.

execution_order: candidate source and focused tests plus evaluator manifest commit and push
run MTV-h target and the other five frozen raw routes twice with candidate flag
run flag-off baseline identity and projected other-route identity checks
run relevant CTest and structural matrix
publish truth-free structural result and documentation
do not open truth in Phase43 regardless of structural outcome
forbidden_actions: use precomputed result/submission coordinates for inference
use device WLS or validation coordinates
change normal SPP quality gates or factor-builder elevation
apply a sentinel factor-level global bypass
change production defaults or the Phase31 champion path
decision_rule: All declared gates are logically ANDed. Any normal/recovery stage-order violation, missing or unhealthy navigation, nonfinite anchor/replay/output, TDCP mismatch, sentinel bypass, flag-off mutation, projected identity failure, or nondeterminism is fail-closed; no truth is opened in Phase43.
